About the job

About the Role:  We are looking for an experienced Lead SDET for our Pulse team, specializing in ensuring the quality and performance of large-scale data systems.In this role, you will work closely with development and operations teams to design and execute comprehensive test strategies for Pulse  product. You will focus on test automation, performance tuning, and identifying bottlenecks in distributed data systems.Your key responsibilities will include writing test plans, creating automated test scripts, and conducting functional, regression, and performance testing. You will be responsible for identifying and resolving defects, ensuring data integrity, and improving testing processes. Strong collaboration skills are essential as you will be interacting with cross-functional teams and driving quality initiatives. Your work will directly contribute to maintaining high-quality standards for big data solutions and enhancing their reliability at scale.https://www.acceldata.io/pulseYou are a great fit for this role if you have      A proactive mindset to define and implement comprehensive test strategies that ensure the highest quality standards are met.Experience in working with both functional and non-functional testing, with a particular focus on automated test development.A collaborative team player with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally with development teams to resolve issues and deliver timely fixes.Strong communication skills with the ability to mentor junior engineers and share knowledge to improve testing practices across the team.A commitment to continuous improvement, with the ability to analyze testing processes and recommend enhancements to align with industry best practices.Ability to quickly learn new technologies

What We Look For      10 years of hands-on experience in quality engineering and quality assurance, focusing on test automation, performance testing, and defect management.Proficiency in programming languages such as Java for writing test scripts and automating test cases with hands-on experience in developing automated tests using other test automation frameworks, ensuring robust and scalable test suites.Proven ability to define and execute comprehensive test

personal_details.label: Senior SDET | API & UI Automation | Java · Python · Microservices
personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: Architected scalable API and microservice test automation frameworks using Java, REST Assured, and BDD Cucumber, building 1,000+ test cases and cutting execution effort by 93%.
Automated end-to-end API flows and database validations using Java test frameworks, integrating suites into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to minimize bug leakage into production.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis and automated Kibana log and data quality validation pipelines, saving 12 hours/week of QA overhead across GCP-hosted microservices.
Leveraged AI-assisted test automation (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
